nora.ali: Quick FYI  rolling out a small MI450 Dedicated preview in Amman (me-1) for regional latency tests. Limited capacity, pilot-only. :sparkles:

ben.wu: Nice. What's the reservation policy and are there any billing differences?

nora.ali: Reservation: 5day window for pilot. No SLA; billing uses standard dedicated rates. Effective unit cost may be higher until we scale.

infra-bot: [automated] pool-create: dedicated-mi450-me-1-01 created (6x MI450). Monitoring ON.

sales-emea: Heads-up to account teams: mark offers as "pilot access" and route requests to eng for onboarding.

ben.wu: Autoscale / preemption?

nora.ali: Autoscale disabled for pilot; non-reserved workloads can be reclaimed during capacity pressure. We'll post a 48h utilization update in this thread.

infra-bot: [automated] alert rule added: mi450-me-1-temp (warn 80%, critical 95%).

nora.ali: Thanks all — follow-up with telemetry and GA guidance after 48h. :white_check_mark:
